candidates.change_summary: Change the payment condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0 so ether is transferred on most blocks instead of only multiples of 15.
Remove the entire if-condition so the balance is transferred unconditionally after updating pastBlockTime.
Delete the require(msg.value == 10 ether) check, allowing calls with any msg.value to update state and trigger conditional transfer.
Change the require condition from > to >=, allowing the same timestamp to be used again and changing when transfers can occur.
Move the pastBlockTime update after the conditional transfer, so the timestamp check uses the old pastBlockTime after a transfer block.
Replace the transfer amount with a fixed value of 1 ether instead of the full balance, changing the balance drained.
Replace msg.sender with a different recipient (e.g., address(this)) so the ether stays in the contract when the condition is met.
